name: org.machanism.machai:bindex-core
description: Bindex Core is a Java 17 library for describing reusable software artifacts with Bindex v2 metadata, registering that metadata, and finding suitable libraries from natural-language requirements. It supplies a typed Bindex schema model, MongoDB-backed persistence, semantic vector search, classification filters, dependency resolution, and AI-facing functional tools. AI agents and MCP integrations can retrieve a descriptor by coordinates, HTTP(S) URL, or project-relative file path; request recommendations using a relevance score and result limit; register descriptors from files, URLs, or in-memory JSON; load the Bindex JSON Schema; and load a generation prompt. The Picker converts requirements into classifications and embeddings through configured GenAI and embedding providers, while MongoBindexRepository stores descriptor JSON and executes vector searches. It is intended for library discovery, application assembly, governed MCP tool publication, and Maven-based Bindex generation workflows.

features.name: get-bindex

features.description: Functional AI tool that retrieves Bindex metadata from registered coordinates, a direct HTTP(S) descriptor URL, or a file path resolved inside the trusted project directory. An optional GraphQL-style selection reduces the returned top-level JSON fields.

examples.description: Ask for a bounded set of high-confidence components during architecture or dependency planning.

features.description: Functional AI tool that loads a Bindex descriptor from a project-relative file or HTTP(S) URL and adds or updates it in the configured repository. Local paths are constrained to the project tree. The default path is bindex.json.

examples.description: After reviewing a generated descriptor at the project root, register it so agents can discover it through semantic search.

features.name: register-bindex-json
features.description: Functional AI tool that registers an already available Bindex JSON object and returns its registration identifier, without requiring an intermediate file or URL.

examples.description: Use this operation when an agent has produced a complete schema-valid descriptor in memory and needs to publish it directly.

features.description: Core semantic-selection workflow used by the AI tool. It obtains a classification from the configured GenAI provider, generates an embedding, and searches the Bindex repository with classification filters, result limits, and a relevance threshold.

examples.description: Program against the repository contract so applications can provide an alternative persistence implementation when necessary.

examples.title: Install and use Bindex Core in a Maven application
steps: Add the Maven dependency for org.machanism.machai:bindex-core:1.4.0.
Configure a reachable MongoDB Bindex repository and the GenAI and embedding providers used for classification and vector generation.
Create MongoBindexRepository and Picker instances, then call Picker.pick with a real requirement and a relevance threshold.

examples.title: Publish Bindex functional tools through a Machai MCP server
steps: Set GENAI_USERNAME, GENAI_PASSWORD, gw.model, embedding.model, and repository settings for the environment.
Start the MCP server with both JAR files on the classpath; use a semicolon as the classpath separator on Windows.
Connect an MCP client and invoke get-bindex, pick-libraries, register-bindex, or register-bindex-json.
examples.scenario: A team runs one governed MCP endpoint that makes library discovery and Bindex registration available to compatible IDE assistants and automation clients.
